findings.finding: Default fakeMega binds RX and TX to one stringstream. Fake available() reports absolute input end even after consumption; availableForWrite() reports output end (zero initially). Naive injection can echo TX into RX, spin on exhausted input or block all TX.
findings.recommendation: Keep default numerical benchmark unmodified. Opt-in adapter needs distinct bounded RX/TX queues with correct queue-length/room semantics.

findings.finding: Production length/CRC readers busy-wait for missing bytes while millis() checks timeout. Deterministic clock freezes during loop(); a partial length/CRC can hang forever if bytes only arrive between loop calls.
findings.recommendation: Serial-only adapter needs concurrent RX and progressing time inside those waits. Characterize stopped-engine communication separately from numerical/timing benchmark; set wall baseline after setup to current virtual time.

findings.finding: Legacy raw F calls inherited Print::print(FlashString), whose fake sends directly to configured ostream. _Serial write overrides alone do not capture it.
findings.recommendation: Bind inherited Print output to actual adapter TX as well; execute production F path, never synthesize a discovery reply.

findings.finding: Disconnect discards staging, but next p/M/d/b lazily opens latest backend without requiring raw F. Source CAS guarantees are per open session; they do not prove a client refreshed its cached page after reconnect. Independent probe confirms next M starts new origin at latest revision.
findings.recommendation: Actual app reconnect test should verify fresh page/cache synchronization before edits; keep claim limited to existing-session CAS. A stricter discovery-only mutation gate is a separate policy choice, not an identified cause of vendor rejection.

findings.finding: Pinned I copies two CAN-ID bytes but transmits sizeof(serialVersion)=4, including trailing prior-buffer bytes.
findings.recommendation: Preserve upstream behavior in genuine reference; do not add this quirk to own I or normalize the reference reply.

findings.finding: Unsent draft is stale at own005/4992-byte page/256-byte runtime while current implementation is own009/8192/640. Root already identified it.
findings.recommendation: Update concrete unsent packet after current app and positive-control results; keep historical own003/004 claims distinct.
